upload_file_to_s3: upload a local file to an S3 bucket using boto3 with the S3_BUCKET environment variable
generate_unique_session_id: generate a unique session ID string from episode indices and connection records with a timestamp
make_s3_filename: transform a session ID and original filename into an S3-friendly filename with sanitized characters
validate_experiment_name: validate that an experiment name is not None, under 128 chars, and contains only allowed characters
review_s3_upload_module: review the s3_upload module functions for uploading files, generating session IDs, and validating names
